title: The Raid on the Upright One's Cattle

plan.english: It was growing dark. Two warriors arrived at the pasture of the Upright One, and there his cattle were standing. The dogs were lying in sleep. Then the two, having seized the cattle, drove them away. Then it grew light. The Upright One woke up and did not see his own cattle, and his heart grew warm. He cried aloud and spoke to the two sons: "Join the swift horses to the chariot, you two! Let us follow those two men who drove our cattle." Then they climbed onto the chariot and drove the horses on. They tracked the cattle. Then at the ford they caught sight of the two. The two, trembling in fear, let the cattle go, and they were swimming through the water. The sons struck them down with javelins. Then the Upright One drove the cattle to the pasture, and men heard of his great fame. At the place of sacrifice he gave a sheep to the gods.

title: The Swift One and the Serpent of the Sea

plan.english: A serpent dwelt at the bottom of the sea. Then that serpent, coming forth from the sea, seized the cattle of the famous father and drove them into the water. Then the father spoke to the brothers: "Who will slay the serpent?" The brothers trembled in fear. But the Swift One stood up and said: "Father, I will slay the serpent. Give me your spear!" Then he gave it to him. The Swift One went to the sea. Then the serpent came forth out of the water. The Swift One wounded it with the spear, and he slew the serpent and split its head, and the water was red. Then the cattle came forth out of the sea, and the brothers were astonished. He gave the Swift One ten cattle and said: "May imperishable fame be yours!"

title: The High One and the Strong One

plan.english: Two troops stood opposite. Then the Strong One stepped forward and cried aloud: "Which man will step against me? My hand killed a group of ten. My fame is great." Then the High One said: "Strong One, I will step against you." The High One lifted up his two hands: "Father Sky, hear me! Give me power!" Then the spear of the Strong One went astray. The High One struck the heart of the Strong One with a javelin. Then the Strong One fell to the earth and grew cold. The troop of the High One grew joyful, and the troop of the Strong One went away. Then the High One, having seized the spear of the Strong One, carried it to the father. He said to him: "Great fame is yours, and that fame of the Strong One is yours!"

title: The Crossing of the Full River

plan.english: The swift warrior was seeking the cattle of his own father. Then he arrived at a great river. The river was full, and its water had become cold, and his horses were trembling. Then he spoke to it: "River, give me a path! I shall give you poured honey." Then he put the honey into the water. The river grew slack, and he found the ford. He led the horses through the ford. On the other side the cattle were eating. Then he drove the cattle through the ford and came to the father. He grew joyful and said: "Beloved one, I shall set a famous name upon you, and your fame will be great."

title: The Sons of Sky and the Drowning Man

plan.english: The Light One was swimming through the sea. He grew tired and sank in the water, and his heart was trembling. Then he cried out to the two sons of Sky: "Sons of Sky, rescue me! Death is in front of me." Then the two heard him, and they joined swift horses to the chariot. The horses carried the chariot over the sea. Then the two drew him out of the water and seated him in the chariot. Then they transported him to his father. He caught sight of him and grew joyful. He gave the two ten horses, and their fame became great.

title: The Quarrel over the Woman

plan.english: The warriors were sitting around the king. They had seized cattle and a woman. Then the giver of good things spoke: "This woman shall be mine." Then the Free One stood up and said: "King, I seized her with my spear. She shall not be yours." The king said to them: "Seize this woman!" Then they took her and led her to him. Then the Free One went away to his own chariot and sat down by the sea, and his tears were flowing. There he spoke a word: "I shall not enter the fight for the giver of good things. May his warriors fall!" Then the fight was great, and they grew cold. But the Free One was sitting at the chariot and did not lift his spear.

title: The Death of the Good One

plan.english: A javelin wounded the Good One. The Good One fell from the chariot and lay upon the earth. His brother arrived and lifted him with his hands. The Good One spoke: "Brother, death has arrived for me. Lead my horses to the mother and say to her: 'Your son did not tremble before death.'" Then he died. The brother transported him by chariot to the mother. She caught sight of him and cried aloud, and her tears were flowing: "Beloved son, you lie upon the earth. You will not see the dawn, and you will not drive the swift horses. But your fame will not vanish." Then they laid him upon the fire, and the brother spoke to Fire: "Fire, carry my brother to the gods!" Then the fire burned him. Men remember his imperishable fame.

title: The King Comes Home in Wool

plan.english: For ten years the king was going about on the sea. Then he arrived at the pasture. He was wearing wool, and he was covering his head, and the men did not know him. That dog of his was lying in the stall. The dog saw him and knew him, and it licked his hand. Then the dog grew cold. He went to the woman. Ten men were sitting there, and they were eating his cattle. The woman said to him: "Who are you?" "I am your husband. I have arrived." She said to him: "If you are my husband, tell me the name of your father." Then he spoke the famous name of his own father, and the woman knew him and grew joyful. Then he seized the spear and killed those ten men. Then he sat down with her, and his fame became good.

title: Wolf and Eagle Exchange Javelins

plan.english: Two warriors came forth out of the troops, and the two were standing face to face, and they lifted their javelins. Then Eagle spoke: "Whose son are you?" "My name is Wolf. My father was the guest of the Long One." Then Eagle grew joyful and put his javelin into the earth: "The Long One was my father. Your father used to sit at our fire, and my father gave him two horses. You are my guest. I indeed remember the pledge. Let us two not enter the fight! Let us two give our javelins in exchange." Then the two gave them in exchange and made a pledge, and the two did not enter the fight. Eagle went away, and Wolf went to the troop.

title: The Race around the Hill

plan.english: The lord had died. Then the brother made ten cattle stand at the hill and said: "Whoever overcomes, to him I shall give the cattle." Then the brother-in-law joined two horses to a chariot, and the Light One joined two horses to a chariot. Then the two drove the swift horses around the hill. Then the horse of the brother-in-law slipped, and his chariot broke. The brother-in-law fell down onto the earth, and his hands became cut, and the Light One passed by him. The horses of the Light One were sweating, and the Light One arrived at the cattle. Then the brother said: "Light One, you overcame. Take the cattle!" He gave the brother-in-law two sheep and said: "Brother-in-law, your horses are swift. Take the two sheep!" And the name of the Light One became famous.

title: The Brother Who Did Not Eat

plan.english: The Drunken One was drinking honey, and he killed a man. He had a brother. The brother heard the word, and his heart grew warm: "I shall not eat, and I shall not drink. Let me find him!" Then the brother, grasping a javelin, followed him. The Drunken One had gone onto a high hill and was lying in sleep. The brother climbed it and saw the Drunken One lying. Then he cried aloud: "Drunken One, wake up! I am the brother of him whom you killed." Then the Drunken One woke up and stood up, and he was trembling. Then the brother bored through his heart with the javelin, and the Drunken One died. Then he drank honey and grew joyful, and his fame was imperishable.

title: The Father and the Warrior

plan.english: The father went away. His son grew up and became a warrior, and in his youth he grew strong. Then the father arrived with a troop, and the warrior stepped against him: "Warrior, who is your father?" "My father went away. Men say: 'He vanished.'" "I am your father." "I do not trust you. Lift your spear!" Then he said: "I shall strike down my son, or my son will strike me down." Then the two struck. The father's spear bored through his heart. The warrior fell to the earth and spoke: "Now, father, I have come to know you." Then he died. He cried aloud and lay down beside him: "Your fame will be imperishable. May death seize me!"

title: The Two Paths of the Beloved

plan.english: The troop was making itself ready. Then the mother of the Beloved said to him: "My son, two paths are before you. If you enter the fight, you will die, and imperishable fame will be yours. If you sit with your father, you will live, and men will not hear your name." The Beloved said: "Mother, I shall enter the fight. A man dies; fame does not die." Then the mother's heart trembled. She clothed him with wool and gave him a spear. Then the Beloved drove the chariot forward. The mother stood on the hill and was looking at him. Death seized the Beloved, and his fame did not die.

title: The Lord's Horses

plan.english: The lord had ten horses in the stall. When it was growing dark, the troop came to the stall. The dogs were lying in sleep. The troop stole the horses and led them over the hill. At dawn the lord did not find them. But his dog had heard them, and it pointed out the path to him. Then the lord followed them with the brothers. By the river they caught sight of the troop. It was cooking a horse. The lord cried aloud: "You stole my horses! Now death will seize you!" Then the troop said: "Lord, do not kill us! We shall give you ten cattle." Then the lord took the cattle and the horses and drove them to the stall, and his fame became great.

title: Perkwunos and the Serpent of the Hill

plan.english: The serpent was lying around the hill, and it had enclosed the waters. The earth dried up, and the bloom vanished, and the cattle were thirsty. The gods said to Perkʷunos: "Perkʷunos, slay the serpent! Free the waters!" Perkʷunos, drinking honey, grew strong. He went to it and struck the serpent. The serpent stood up against him. Then Perkʷunos slew the serpent and split the hill. The waters came forth out of the hill, and the rivers were going to the sea. Then it rained. The cattle drank, and the earth was productive, and bloom came forth. The gods said: "Perkʷunos, you who slew the serpent, you who freed the waters, your fame is imperishable."

title: The Hale One and the Daughter of Sky

plan.english: The Hale One woke up. It grew bright. He stood up and spoke to Dawn: "Dawn, daughter of Sky, hear my word! I am going into the fight. Ten warriors are standing against me. May I see your light!" Dawn heard him. Then the Hale One entered the fight and killed nine warriors. Then a javelin wounded him. The Hale One was lying upon the earth, and the sun went down. It grew dark. Then dawn broke, and the Hale One caught sight of her light and died. The daughter of Sky cried aloud.

title: The Guest Who Was a God

plan.english: The Upright One dwelt at the ford, and his daughter was milking the cattle. Then a guest arrived, and he was tired. The Upright One seated him at the fire, and she carried a washbasin to him. She cooked a sheep for him and gave him honey and water. He ate, and he drank. Then he said: "Upright One, you were giving me good things. I am a god. I am seeking that which is proper." The Upright One was astonished. The god said: "Do not become afraid! May your sheep increase, and may your daughter meet a good husband!" Then the god stepped up to the sky, and the sheep of the Upright One increased. In the spring his daughter met a good husband, and his good fame became great.

title: Otter and the Lofty One at the Fire

plan.english: The father-in-law was cooking cattle. Otter and the Lofty One were sitting around the fire, and they were drinking honey, and the two became drunk. Then the Lofty One spoke: "Otter, your hand is lightweight, and your heart trembles." Otter stood up and said: "Lofty One, my hand is not lightweight. Let us two go out and fight with fists!" Then the father-in-law stood up between them and spoke: "Otter and Lofty One, do not fight with fists! You two are drunk. A guest is dear to the lord. Lie down, you two!" Then the two lay down. At dawn the two woke up, and Otter gave the Lofty One a javelin, and the Lofty One gave Otter two horses. Then they became sated.

title: Wolf Breaks the Pledge

plan.english: Wolf and the two brothers made a pledge. Wolf spoke: "Father Sky, listen to my word! I shall not steal the cattle of the brothers. If I steal them, may Perkʷunos strike me!" But in the spring Wolf caught sight of the brothers' cattle in the pasture. When it was growing dark, he drove them to his own stall. At dawn the two brothers were seeking the cattle. They tracked them to his stall and were saying: "Wolf, you broke the pledge." He said: "I did not steal them." Then clouds were coming, and Perkʷunos struck Wolf with fire. Wolf fell, and his stall was burning. The cattle came forth out of it, and the two brothers drove them to the pasture. Whoever breaks a pledge, Perkʷunos strikes him.

title: The Lament for the Husband

plan.english: The woman's husband fell in the fight. Her husband's brother transported him by chariot. The woman caught sight of him and cried aloud, and she struck her own breast: "Husband, you are lying down. You do not look at the sun. You do not listen to my word. Who will protect me? Who will guard the sheep?" The husband's brother spoke: "Woman, do not become afraid! I shall protect you and the sheep." Then the two put together a fire and laid him on it. The fire burned him, and its radiance went up to the sky. The husband's brother set his spear upright on the hill and said: "May men see it, and may they remember his name! His fame will be imperishable."

title: The Daughter and the Wolf

plan.english: The daughter of the Free One was guarding the sheep in the pasture. When it was growing dark, a wolf was coming. The sheep trembled in fear. The daughter lifted the burning fire and went to it. She singed its head. The wolf, trembling, went away. Then the Free One heard the word and said: "Daughter, you protected the sheep. I shall set a name upon you, and it will be famous." Then he gave the daughter a dog, and the dog was guarding them with her.

title: The Ambush at the Ford

plan.english: The son-in-law was standing on the stronghold, and he was looking at the river. He saw strangers coming along the river, and they were driving chariots. He went down to the king and was saying: "King, strangers are coming with chariots." The king said: "Let us stand at the ford and hide ourselves." Then they hid themselves at the ford. The strangers arrived at the ford, and the chariots entered the water. Then they stood up and struck them with javelins. The water was red. The wheels broke, and they sank in the water. The king seized their horses and gave them to the son-in-law and said: "Son-in-law, you were awake. Good fame is yours."

title: The Sister Heals Her Brother

plan.english: The brother fell from the chariot, and his head became cut. He was lying on the earth, and he did not wake up. His dear one lifted him and was carrying him to his sister. The sister caught sight of her own brother and cried aloud. Then she heated water and smeared honey on his head, and she covered his head with wool. She sat beside him, and she was awake: "Father Sky, may my brother live!" At dawn the brother woke up and spoke: "Sister, I am thirsty." She gave him water, and he drank, and he became healthy. Then he said: "Sister, you freed me from death. May a famous name be yours!"

title: The Guest Who Won the Daughter

plan.english: A king had a daughter. She was wearing an ornament. Whoever overcame him with the chariot, to him he would give her. Whoever did not overcome him, him he would kill. Then a guest arrived from the sea, and the daughter caught sight of him and came to love him. She said to him: "I shall split the chariot of my father." Then the two drove around the hill. The father's chariot split, and the king slipped. His horses pulled him, and death seized him. The guest took her and the horses, and he became king, and she was his woman, and his name became famous.

title: The Long One and the Wild Horse

plan.english: A wild horse dwelt beside the river. Men could not overcome it, and it broke chariots. Then the Long One, carrying honey, was going to the river, and he sat down. The wild horse stepped up and licked the honey. The Long One was grasping its head. The horse was trembling, and it was sweating. Then the Long One spoke to it: "Horse, do not become afraid! I shall not kill you." The horse became accustomed to the Long One. Then he joined it to a chariot and drove to his father. The father was astonished and said: "You overcame the wild horse. You will overcome men, and your fame will be imperishable."

title: Dog at the Ford

plan.english: A warrior was standing at the ford, and Dog was his name. The strangers were coming against him, and he killed a group of ten, and the ford was red. Then they wounded him, and he grew tired. He said: "I shall not lie down. Standing, I shall die." He leaned on the chariot. Then death came to him. They did not come near him, and they were trembling. Then an eagle stepped up and sat down upon his head. Then they came near and were cutting off his head. The fame of Dog is great.

title: The Mother between the Brothers

plan.english: The cattle and horses were in the stall. When death seized the father, the two brothers were separating the cattle. The Greater said: "The horses shall be mine, and the cattle shall be yours." The Free One said: "The horses shall not be yours." And he lifted his hand against his brother. Then their mother stepped between them and spoke: "Brothers, do not fight with fists! Your father is looking at you from the sky. May the Greater take the horses, and may the Free One take the cattle, and may the two make a pledge at the fire." The two listened to the mother. They made a pledge and drank, and the mother grew joyful.

title: The Horses Who Wept for Their Master

plan.english: Death seized the master of the swift horses. The horses were standing beside the chariot, and they did not enter the fight. They put their heads down to the earth, and their tears were flowing. They drove them on, and they did not move. Father Sky caught sight of them and spoke: "Horses, death does not seize you; death seizes men. Enter the fight! Carry your master's chariot!" Then he gave them power. The horses shook themselves and transported the chariot forward. They remember him.

title: The Brothers Free Their Sister

plan.english: Strangers seized the sister of the two brothers and led her into their own stronghold. The stronghold was high, and its wall was long. The two brothers went to the wall and cried aloud: "Sister, are you alive?" The sister heard them and said: "I am alive. They are guarding me." When it was growing dark, they climbed the wall. They were lying in sleep. Then the brothers caught sight of the sister and freed her. But the lord of the stronghold woke up and followed them. At the ford the two stood up against him and killed him. Then the sister swam through the river with the brothers, and their father grew joyful, and their fame is imperishable.

title: The Journey to the Wheel of the Sun

plan.english: The Hale One wanted to see the wheel of the sun. He was going along the path of the sun. For a year he was walking, and his nails split. He swam through waters and climbed hills. Then he arrived at the sea. There the sun came forth out of the water. The wheel of the sun was burning, and its light was great. The Hale One was astonished and spoke to the sun: "Sun, where is my father?" The sun said: "He is with the gods. He drank honey, and he is satisfied. Go to your mother! When you die, you will see him." The Hale One arrived at her and told her the word of the sun, and the mother's heart grew warm.
